prompt: A store takes $20\%$ off a price, then adds a flat $\$5$ shipping charge. You paid $\$45$ in the end. What was the original price in dollars?
hint: Undo the machines in REVERSE order. Shipping was added LAST, so take it off FIRST.

hints.text: Undo the machines in REVERSE order. Shipping was added LAST, so take it off FIRST.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm up: a price is halved, then $\$2$ is added, ending at $\$7$. Undo backwards: $7 - 2 = 5$, then $5 \times 2 = 10$. Same order of undoing here.
Remove the shipping: $45 - 5 = 40$. That $40$ dollars is the discounted price, which is $80\%$ of the original, so divide it by $0.8$.
Dividing gives $40 \div 0.8 = 50$, so the original price was $50$ dollars.

explanation: Shipping was the last thing added, so remove it first: $45 - 5 = 40$ dollars.
A $20\%$ discount means the $40$ dollars is $80\%$ of the original price, so the original times $0.8$ equals $40$.
Dividing undoes that multiplication: $40 \div 0.8 = 50$, so the original price was $50$ dollars.

alternativeExplanations.title: Run it forward to check
steps: Start at $\$50$. Take $20\%$ off: that is $\$10$ off, leaving $\$40$.
That matches what you paid, so $\$50$ is right.
